title: UML class-diagram modeling exercise bank
summary: Learners receive natural-language requirements and construct UML class diagrams that represent classes, attributes, methods, and relationships. The paper evaluates 20 existing educational exercises and tests whether LLM-generated diagrams could serve as sample solutions.

sources.title: Evaluating Large Language Models in Exercises of UML Class Diagram Modeling
